name: Catapult Sports Ltd
summary: Catapult Sports Ltd, a sports science and analytics company, engages in the development and supply of technologies that improve the performance of athletes and sports teams in Australia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and the Americas. The company operates in three segments: Performance & Health; Tactics & Coaching; and Media & Other.
